label_policy: HOLDOUT-DTI = local catalogue-truth proxy (not organizer). ORGANIZER-PUBLIC = public leaderboard page (not a submission-page receipt). Nothing here is a projection.
scope: Review of the CGRC v1 candidate, the 0.2778 registry pair, the detection-floor question, hypothesis ranking, and the submission gates. No submission was made and no weekly slot was chosen.
hypothesis: Catalogue-tip relay: continue mapped fault traces past their tips along strike (two-sided outward continuations, gap and extension capped at 2,500 m), place 300 m-spaced dots on the continuations, and weight placement by SGMC corroboration.
mechanism: Straight-line extrapolation of mapped tips along local trend, scored by the distance-weighted Tversky index on new faults; the SGMC layer is used only as a placement weight.
named_non_fault_mimic: Tip continuations that follow aligned basin-margin or topographic lineaments rather than faults (a straight extension of a mapped trace can run along a basin edge with no fault).
